episodes.title: Gabe Cazares former mayor of Clearwater, Florida and critic of L. Ron Hubbard & Scientology
episodes.description:
Gabe Cazares (1920-2006) was the former mayor of Clearwater, Florida, a civil rights advocate, and a critic of L. Ron Hubbard & the Church of Scientology.
"Secret Lives"
Scientology - Dianetics.

This video is uploaded with the intent of educating the public regarding Scientology and its belief structure and to help preserve the tech for future generations.
